اضطهدن (form VIII)
# اِضْطَهَدْنَ (iḍṭahadna) /idˤ.tˤa.had.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اُضْطُهِدْنَ (uḍṭuhidna) /udˤ.tˤu.hid.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# اِضْطَهِدْنَ (iḍṭahidna) /idˤ.tˤa.hid.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
